GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (29 Dec 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 510)
29 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Reception Centers in Japan for Processing Repatriates.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. No.1331 (5.2), dated 26 December, subject as above.
2. Careful consideration has been given to establishing a reception center at Tanabe, Wakayama Prefecture, At present, however, established reception centers in Japan are adequate to handle repatriation traffic. Tanabe may be utilized as a center at some time in the future.
3. In view of above, the request in reference C. L. O. is disapproved at this time.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
